name: BCS Junk Removal
summary: A 15-yard dumpster with rear double doors. The company says it fits in one parking space. Serves College Station, Bryan, and nearby towns including Navasota, Brenham, Caldwell, Somerville, and Iola.
accepted: Terms say any non-flammable junk. Tires are taken for an extra fee of $10 each.
prohibited: Terms say they do not accept brush or hazardous waste. If you are not sure, call before the appointment.
gaps: Included tons on the dumpster rental (the dump fee is per ton)

junkRemoval.summary: Junk removal prices from the company's own pages, checked Nov 23, 2026. The company says online prices can change with the job. The detailed list shows furniture and appliances at $20 to $30 each. The same page also says the cost of additional items is set when you get a quote.

items.label: Minimum
items.detail: Includes one item of your choice

items.label: Full 15-yard haul-off
items.detail: Flat price. The page says they fill the 15-yard container.

items.label: Live load, 15-yard, 45 minutes
items.detail: You load it while the driver waits.

items.label: Live load, 15-yard, 90 minutes
items.detail: You load it while the driver waits. Up to 1 ton permitted, then $60 per ton.

items.label: Late cancel
items.detail: Less than 24 hours notice: half of the appointment total
